readme: Byte copies of the sealed CoreTex final-cut local e2e evidence, enough for the standalone client
to reconstruct genesis -> efficiency -> prior_accept with only its own validator/replay code:
every CAS object both evaluation artifacts address, the genesis baseline the first witness
names, and the shared epoch context. Copied from botcoin-coordinator (branch
coretex-law-v2-bounded-trade, HEAD c35a9f10, working tree); each object records its source
path(s) and sha256. No worker results, receipts, or signatures are included; the test builds the
transition descriptor from the addressed roots. Objects are base64 because two are Python
modules and the package requires tests/fixtures to hold only flat JSON files.
Consumed by tests/test_law_v2_two_transition_reconstruction.py, which refuses any byte drift.
